comment: Teens use MAM-only app protection (see android-app-protection-baseline.json), which does not
require device enrollment or compliance (deviceComplianceRequired: false there), exactly like
the adult tier. Without this restriction, Company Portal offers to set up an Android Enterprise
Work Profile the moment a teen signs in - creating an unwanted managed container on a personal
phone. platformBlocked blocks Android Enterprise enrollment entirely for the teen tier; MAM app
protection for Outlook/OneDrive/Office/Edge/Teams is unaffected since it never enrolls the
device. Priority is 3, not 2: priority must be unique per platformType, and priority 2 is
already held by adult-enrollment-restriction-android-for-work.json for this platformType.
name: teen-enrollment-restriction-android-for-work

payload.displayName: CaC - Enrollment - Teen Personal Devices (Android for Work)
payload.description: Managed by sf-intune-cac. Do not edit in the portal.
